summary: Fixed the ledger package to follow docs/conventions.md: half-away-from-zero rounding via ledger.core (incl. cross rates, recurring medians, spark bars), single-minus amount formatting and HTML total cells, header-over-dialect layout, fiscal quarter year, 6-month earlier-only rate lookback, rate-file month ranges, reversals booked/valued/taxed as their original, per-entry rounded sums in monthly/journal/revalue, tax rules effective on their date, returns by valuation quarter, writer always writing jurisdiction. All 755 tests pass; tools/audit.py has one remaining failed check (rule 6.2) because it expects a 3-month lookback, which contradicts the 6-month MAX_LOOKBACK in conventions.md section 6.2, so I followed the document.
